entries.note: Re-attestation at 3d0f77762a (translation-reviewer, lopdev), five clause keys read as ONE composed sentence. Composed: 前两个选项只改变 **本会话** 而已；最后一个则把其后 **所有会话的默认值** 改掉。 (the four spaces are injected by the component, not present in any key). Meaning preserved: 只 ... 而已 confines the first two choices to 本会话 - 而已 is the standard restrictive partner of 只 and carries meaning rather than padding; 则 carries the contrast; 把 ... 改掉 is the disposal construction that keeps '所有会话的默认值' a unit and lets the verb close the sentence in 'after', and 改掉 adds a completive 'change away' flavour that en's plain 'changes' lacks (acceptable, mildly colloquial). Not over-emphatic: one restrictive and one contrastive marker. Bold: '本会话' and '所有会话的默认值' - both complete; 其后 stays plain exactly as en's 'that follow it' does. FINDING (minor, open, REGRESSION, component-level): the pre-split single key contained zero spaces; the five-key join inserts four U+0020 between Han characters (改变|本, 话|而, 后|所, 值|改), which Chinese typography does not use and which zh-CN.md's no-space discipline and its cell budget both argue against: four visible gaps in a 33-character sentence, and four extra cells under the guide's own model (ASCII = 1 cell, CJK = 2), 70 cells against the 66 the Han text itself costs. The copy is right; the join is wrong for CJK. Confidence: medium-high on meaning, medium on register. LIMITATION: same model as the first pass; no rendered frame captured - the defect follows from the join rule, not from a screenshot. Evidence: i18n/audits/evidence/zh-CN/relay.approvals/ap25b1/record.json FIXED in f2d888f42a: the join is now locale-aware in the component, so this note describes a defect that no longer exists at the attested head - zh/ja/ko concatenate and fr takes U+202F. Recorded rather than edited away, because a note that outlives its defect is how the programme has repeatedly mis-reported its own state.

Restored byte-identically from 3bd709c0f4 after the hold that deleted it was lifted; 77/77 keys, 0 placeholder mismatches, 4 plural keys all other-only with a rendering '#', no bidi controls, no English leakage except the intentional mode token 'ask'. Scope audit of the gate labels it carries: '继续询问（ask）' / '无需询问直接运行（auto）' / '在所有会话中无需询问直接运行（default auto）' — the session-only vs all-sessions distinction survives and 'run without asking' keeps its risk. Dispositions of the five findings left to this round: (1) sheet.title_plain '提问' — MINOR and the same defect class the other six locales were fixed for on 2026-10-20 (their rows record 'demandes'/'consultas'/'पूछताछ'/'запросы'/'yêu cầu'/'درخواستیں' as section nouns 'distinct from' the question word); 提问 is the question-asking verb, so the sheet that also holds approvals and secrets is named with the question word. Not major: rows inside carry their own kind labels and the dock badge is unchanged, so no approval is granted or missed because of it; recommend '请求' (already used in card.request_needs_answer) in the next copy pass. (2) pending.kind_approval '需要审批' / kind_secret '需要机密信息' — MINOR. 需要审批 is accurate and is the vocabulary gate.body/notice_auto already use, and the verbal form is not a zh-only deviation (ru 'требуется одобрение', vi 'cần phê duyệt' are verbal too); the weak point is '机密信息' for a secret value, since zh has no recorded credentials/secret rendering (glossary §2 note 6 leaves the zh cell '—') — the card's masked field and card.secret_notice carry the meaning. (3) card.decline and pending.deny both '拒绝' — MINOR. They never co-occur (decline sits beside 'send answer' on the ask card, deny beside 'approve' on the approval card) and five of seven locales collapse them identically (fr 'refuser', hi 'अस्वीकार करें', vi 'từ chối', ur 'انکار کریں'); the English pair is a register distinction, not a functional one, and both refuse. (4) gate.unpaired_after '模式从不需要配对。' — MINOR. It extends the bold 'ask' label with 模式 (necessary in Chinese) but joins without a connective; rendered it reads '将审批保持在 ask 模式从不需要配对。' — understandable, slightly run-on, no meaning loss. (5) sheet.loading '……' — REJECTED, not a defect: the zh style guide mandates '…… (two marks)' and 62 other zh catalogue strings already use it (tui.library.loading, relay.session.past.loading, mobile.setup.checking), while the six single-'…' strings are all inside comma-separated Latin lists; the sidecar's 'The ellipsis is U+2026' pins the character class, not a count. Additional NIT found here: dock.waiting/dock.timed_out/title_waiting write '# 个…' with a space while title_lapsed writes '{count}个…' without one — pick one convention. 4 MINOR + 1 NIT, 0 blocker, 0 major, so this row attests; minors do not force another round but should ride the next zh copy pass.
